Picocomputer 6502 for Analogue Pocket
=====================================

Always begin at the documentation:
https://picocomputer.github.io/


Install
-------

Copy everything into the same folder structure on a microSD card.
The Cores, Platforms, Saves, and Assets folders merge with the ones
already on the card; nothing here replaces another core's files.

The Pocket needs firmware 2.3 or later. Open the core from the
Pocket menu under openFPGA.


Saves
-----

Programs save to Saves/rp6502/common/, which is the core's working
directory. The Pocket will not create this path automatically; you
will find a .keep file there to ensure the zip file retains the
directory structure.


ROMs
----

6502 software is distributed as files ending with ".rp6502". Put
them in Assets/rp6502/common/ on the card; the core asks you to
pick one when it opens. Find them on Discord, which has a forum
for ROMs, or on itch.io under the RP6502 tag:

    https://discord.gg/TC6X8kTr6d
    https://itch.io/games/tag-rp6502
